_comment: 2026-06-29 (item 5): spawnY is PP's TOP-LEFT, foot = topLeft+270. A floor CLICK lands foot = clickY+135 (setTarget subtracts 135 then the draw adds 270). NOTE the old _comment_walk 'footWalk=true' was wrong — there is no footWalk field, so the walkSegments are click-points, not foot-lines; that mismatch is why PP kept landing too low. Tuned to the BG: the dirt clearing in front of the fence sits at foot y≈665-760. spawn 435 → foot 705 (standing in the clearing); band 392-485 → foot 662-755.
_comment_walk: Click-point lines (foot = clickY+135). Line 1 = the clearing in front of the fence: clickY 580 -> foot ~715. Line 2 = the dirt path running UP toward the gate, top end clickY 546 -> foot ~681 (PP recedes up the path). Both are clamped into the minY/maxY band so PP's feet stay in the clearing.
